results.title: LayerMatch: Do Pseudo - labels Benefit All Layers?
results.content: Semi-supervised learning (SSL), par-ticularly through pseudo-labeling algorithms that iteratively assign pseudo-labels for self-training, offers a promising solution to mitigate the dependency of labeled data. In this context, semi-supervised learning (SSL) emerges as a pivotal approach, enabling models to extract valuable information from a wealth of unlabeled data, thereby reducing the dependency on labeled data [91, 103, 80]. FixMatch (yellow curve) significantly outperforms the only supervised learning method using labeled data (red dashed line), highlighting the effectiveness of pseudo-labeling combined with consistency regularization in leveraging unlabeled data to enhance model performance. This reduces the impact of pseudo-label inaccuracies on the linear classification layer and maintains the learning integrity of the feature extraction layer. The contributions of this work are summarized as follows: (1) We identify the discrepancy learning behaviors of pseudo-labels between the feature extraction layer and the linear classification layer in SSL. Selects pseudo-labels based on the threshold τ; (c) Learning from both labels and pseudo-labels, where the model uses pseudo-labels generated from unlabeled data for training. It includes two layer-wise pseudo-label strategies: "Grad-ReLU" and "Avg-Clustering." 4.2.1 Grad-ReLU The Grad-ReLU addresses the negative impact of pseudo-labels on the model’s classification layer in semi-supervised learning. Meanwhile, by retaining the influence of the unsupervised loss gradients in the feature extraction layer, Grad-ReLU allows the feature extraction layer to learn the clustering features of the data from pseudo-labels, effectively capturing the data distribution. Grad-ReLU effectively separates the learning tasks of different layers, allowing the model to benefit more stably from unsupervised data while avoiding the adverse effects of pseudo-labels on the classification layer. Future work should focus on designing a method that selects pseudo-labels for self-training different layers based on the learning state of each layer. Title: [논문요약] Semi-superviesd의 정수 - Meta Pseudo Labels(2021)
## [논문요약] Semi-superviesd의 정수 - Meta Pseudo Labels(2021). "Meta Pseudo Labels"는 EfficientNet을 기본으로 사용하고 있지만,. "**Meta Pseudo Labels**"의 의미가 단순히 성능에 국한되어 있지 않다는 것을 알 수 있습니다. - 반면, "**Meta Pseudo Labels**"은 480M parameter로 상대적으로 작은(?) 모델 크기를 보여줍니다. #### **Meta Pseudo Labels****소개**. 2. 학습한 Teacher로 Unlabeled data에서의 Pseudo Label 생성. 3. Labeled data와 Pseudo Label가 생성된 Unlabeled data을 결합. - Teacher가 부정확한 경우 → Pseudo label 부정확 → Student는 잘 못된 Pseudo label을 학습. #### **Meta Pseudo Labels****의의**. - 학생의 피드백을 활용(feedback from the student) → teacher to generate better pseudo labels. - Student Network → Unlabeled data에서 Pseudo Label로 학습. 4. Meta Pseudo Labels 학습의 효율성  :. #### **Meta Pseudo Labels 설명**. * **Meta Pseudo Labels 최적화 방안**. 가 Meta Pseudo Label 방법의 최종적인 (이중) 목적함수. * **Meta Pseudo Labels 최적화 어려움**. * **Meta Pseudo Labels 최적화 해결방안**. * **Meta Pseudo Labels 최적화 세부내용**. - 작은 실험에서, soft pseudo label과 hard pseudo label 간의 테스트 성능 차이 없었음. - 단, hard pseudo label 사용 시, “modified version of REINFORCE“을 사용. * **Meta Pseudo Labels 최적화 - Teacher’s auxiliary losses**. #### **Meta Pseudo Labels 실험 결과 (Small Scale)**. - 비교 : Supervised vs Pseudo Labels(Semi-Supervised 기본) vs Meta Pseudo Labels. 2. Pseudo labels : Unlabeled Data 활용. 3. Meta Pseudo labels : 학생 모델의 손실 피드백을 사용하여 교사를 조정하여 더 나은 의사 레이블을 생성. - "Meta Pseudo Labels" 학습 방법 :. 2. Meta Pseudo Labels 학습 완료 후, labeled dataset으로 the student를 finetune. - "Meta Pseudo Labels" 성능 다른 방법보다 좋음. - "Meta Pseudo Labels" 학습 방법 :. ○ teacher는 labeled images으로 학습 후, student의 피드백으로 한 번 더 학습. ○ student는 unlabeled로 학습 후, labeled images로 평가. #### **Meta Pseudo Labels 실험 결과 (Large Scale)**. ○ 좀 더 적은 비용으로 학습하는 Meta Pseudo Labels의 라이트 버전도 설계. → "Reduced Meta Pseudo Labels"라는 두 개의 네트워크를 동시에 메모리에 유지할 필요를 없앰. - Supervised Loss(labeled data)와 Unsupervised Loss(unlabeled data)를 결함. - Semi-supervised learning을 위한 Meta Pseudo Labels 방법을 제안. 이러한 Meta Pseudo Label 방식은 새로운 탈출구를 보여주었습니다. ### Tag. Deep, Label, learning, meta, pseudo, semi, semi-supervised, SOTA, supervised. * 현재글**[논문요약] Semi-superviesd의 정수 - Meta Pseudo Labels(2021)**.

results.content: Exploiting Completeness and Uncertainty of Pseudo Labels for Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection Chen Zhang1,2 Guorong Li3* Yuankai Qi4 Shuhui Wang5,6 Laiyun Qing3 Qingming Huang1,2,3,5 Ming-Hsuan Yang7,8 1State Key Laboratory of Information Security, Institute of Information Engineering, CAS 2School of Cyber Security, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences 3School of Computer Science and Technology, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences 4Australian Institute for Machine Learning, The University of Adelaide 5Key Laboratory of Intelligent Information Processing, Institute of Computing Technology, CAS 6Peng Cheng Laboratory, 7University of California, Merced, 8Yonsei University zhangchen@, liguorong@, qykshr@gmail.com, wangshuhui@, {lyqing, qmhuang}@, mhyang@ucmerced.edu Abstract Weakly supervised video anomaly detection aims to iden-tify abnormal events in videos using only video-level labels. Pipeline of the proposed method: (1) Completeness Enhanced Pseudo Label Generator (Sec. 3.2): First, we use the pre-trained 3D CNN to extract video features. [5] propose a self-training framework in which clip-level pseudo labels generated by a multiple instance pseudo label generator are assigned to all clips of abnormal videos to refine feature encoder. We first use a multi-head classifier trained with a diversity loss and MIL ranking loss to generate initial clip-level pseudo labels. Completeness of Pseudo Labels Inspired by [13], which uses a diversity loss to model action completeness, we design a completeness enhanced pseudo label generator composed of parallel multi-head classifier, together with a diversity loss to detect as many abnormal events as possible in a video. Thus we can use all reliable temporal features set ΩR(C) and reliable clip-level pseudo labels ΩR( ˜ Y) to train the clip classifier fc based on the binary cross entropy loss: LXE = X ci,t∈ΩR(C) −(˜ yi,t log (fc(ci,t)) +(1 −˜ yi,t) log (1 −fc(ci,t))) (11) where ˜ yi,t ∈ΩR( ˜ Y) represents the pseudo label of the tth clip in the ith video. In the second stage, we mine reliable video clips with uncertainty estimation to train the clip classifier using Eq. 11 and gradually refine clip-level pseudo labels through multiple iterations. We start with the baseline that directly uses the MIL-based method as a pseudo label generator and then selects all the pseudo labels to train a clip-level classifier.
